snippet.title: Seven Samurai 20XX | PS2 | 2004 | Video Game US Trailer | LQ/OGR
snippet.description:
US Trailer for the Seven Samurai 20XX video game, inspired on the Seven Samurai 1954 film by Akira Kurosawa.

Published in United States by Sammy Corporation in 2004 for PlayStation 2
Developed by Dimps Corporation and Polygon Magic

Trailer in low quality. Original resolution.
